items.rule_gloss: A wardrobes, B per van, vans rounded up, times C taka each
items.gloss_en: Last month {T} wardrobes moved. Now {A} must move; each van fits {B}; each van rents for {C} taka. If a partly filled last van must still be hired, what is the total rent?
